scripts.web: nc -z 127.0.0.1 3000 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { node src/db/server.js & DB=$!; trap "kill $DB" EXIT INT TERM; }; open -na "Brave Browser" --args --user-data-dir=/tmp/first-app-brave --allow-file-access-from-files "file://$(pwd)/src/clients/web/index.html"; wait
scripts.http: nc -z 127.0.0.1 3000 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { node src/db/server.js & DB=$!; trap "kill $DB" EXIT INT TERM; }; node src/clients/http/server.js
scripts.electron: nc -z 127.0.0.1 3000 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { node src/db/server.js & DB=$!; trap "kill $DB" EXIT INT TERM; }; electron src/clients/electron/main.js
scripts.chrome: nc -z 127.0.0.1 3000 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { node src/db/server.js & DB=$!; trap "kill $DB" EXIT INT TERM; }; node src/clients/chrome/server.js
scripts.nest: nc -z 127.0.0.1 3000 >/dev/null 2>&1 || { node src/db/server.js & DB=$!; trap "kill $DB" EXIT INT TERM; }; rm -rf dist && babel src -d dist --config-file ./babel.config.json && node dist/clients/nest/main.js
